reviews.summary: Uniqlo lists 4.3/5 from 39 ratings for AIRism Ultra Seamless Boxer Briefs. Recent customer reviews praise the barely-there comfort and seamless feel; others report ride-up and dissatisfaction with Uniqlo's return/exchange policy. A December 2024 r/Ultralight gear review of the Ultra Seamless style (related Singapore listing E456710, same $14.90 regular price) called them comfortable, quick-drying, and good value; commenters were split on warmth, odor, and ride-up, and noted that Uniqlo sells several different AIRism constructions.
